tasks.title: Expose bounded graph operations through typed Electron IPC
acceptance_criteria: Electron main builds and stores a selected active project graph in MDS_DATA_DIR/mds.sqlite.
Preload exposes DTO-only build, query, node, and validation operations.
Project paths and query limits are validated before application calls.
risks: IPC must not expose arbitrary filesystem or SQLite access.

tasks.title: Verify graph IPC through the sandboxed renderer bridge
acceptance_criteria: Smoke verification builds and queries the EduMeet graph through window.mds.
The known broken reference is returned through validation IPC.
No graph UI, watcher, or Graph RAG code is introduced.
risks: Smoke execution writes only to an isolated MDS_DATA_DIR.
